about: A reader region of a capsule a place can run reads where the place's own lock offers it — region/<name> measure=leaves — through the first capsule, pinned before carried, that writes the region, handed the offered leaves it declares it reads, a reader that runs over its place its sources alone. It takes over exactly what a reader line of the tree read: it runs at a place a withdrawn line reached for the same capsule region, and nowhere a standing line still reaches, so nothing is read twice and nothing is read that no line read before.
